surfaces.name: Helmor Tauri desktop app (macOS, Windows x64)
helmor CLI and stdio MCP server

claims.answer: Tauri desktop app for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows x64, a helmor CLI, and an experimental phone-browser companion over a Cloudflare tunnel; no native mobile app, Linux build or editor extension.

desktop_os.answer: Release assets include macOS aarch64 and x64 DMGs and a Windows x64 installer; FAQ lists macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows (x64) as supported.

mobile_apps.answer: No native iOS/Android app in releases or source.

browser.answer: The companion serves the same frontend to a browser through a tunnel, but it is experimental and not a general browser client.

mobile_browser.answer: Experimental companion pairs a phone browser to the desktop over a Cloudflare tunnel, gated by HELMOR_COMPANION.

cli.answer: helmor CLI installed from Settings with machine-readable --json output.

task_actions.answer: Start, steer, approve (questions, permissions, plan approval), review diffs and resume sessions in the desktop app; CLI can create workspaces and send prompts.

notifications.answer: Desktop notifications with sounds when an agent finishes or needs input.

cross_device_continuity.answer: State is local; the experimental companion lets a phone drive the desktop while it is on.

limitations: No Linux build; no native mobile app; the mobile companion is experimental and gated behind an environment variable.

claims.answer: Bundles and drives Claude Code (Claude Agent SDK), Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode and Kimi Code through a sidecar; custom Claude-compatible providers and OpenCode providers add models; sessions can use different agents.

harnesses.answer: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode documented; Kimi Code listed in README and present in the sidecar.

mixed_harness_operation.answer: Model and agent are chosen per session, so different sessions in one workspace can use different agents.

limitations: No generic adapter for arbitrary agent CLIs.

claims.answer: Reuses existing Claude Code and Codex logins (subscription) or API keys, a Cursor API key, OpenCode providers and custom endpoints; no vendor credits.

evidence.title: Helmor README
evidence.locator: Features; How it works; Get started; CLI
evidence.finding: Local-first workbench running many coding agents in isolated git workspaces with diffs, editor, terminals and PR actions; Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Kimi Code; macOS and Windows x64; CLI and MCP server; experimental mobile companion; Apache-2.0.

evidence.title: Agents and models
evidence.locator: Supported agents; Modes; Local models
evidence.finding: Four documented agents with their sign-in routes (Claude subscription or key, Codex ChatGPT or key, Cursor API key, OpenCode providers), custom Claude-compatible providers, per-session model and effort, plan/fast/terminal modes, bundled llama.cpp for titles.

evidence.title: Privacy
evidence.locator: What stays on your machine; What leaves
evidence.finding: No Helmor cloud or account; data in ~/helmor/ SQLite; only user-initiated traffic; update checks via GitHub releases; no analytics pipeline; feedback only when used.

evidence.title: FAQ
evidence.locator: Is Helmor free?; Which platforms are supported?; GitLab
evidence.finding: Open source and free; supported platforms macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows (x64); GitHub and GitLab supported.

evidence.title: Install
evidence.locator: Download; First launch; Where your data lives
evidence.finding: DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel, Windows x64 setup; bundled agent CLIs and gh/glab; onboarding steps; data under ~/helmor.

evidence.title: Workspaces
evidence.locator: Isolation through git worktrees; Workspace modes; Lifecycle
evidence.finding: One git worktree and branch per workspace; Local and Chat modes; status lanes In Progress/Review/Done/Backlog/Canceled; archive and restore.

evidence.title: Parallel agents
evidence.locator: Knowing where you are needed; Organizing the fleet
evidence.finding: Sidebar shows Running, Needs input, Unread; status lanes kanban-style grouping; notifications; quick panel; CLI dispatch.

evidence.title: Sessions
evidence.locator: Questions and permissions; Context usage; Resume
evidence.finding: Interactive panels for agent questions/permissions/plan approval; context ring; sessions survive restarts with provider session resume; several sessions share one workspace.

evidence.title: Review and ship
evidence.locator: Changes; Actions; Terminals; Run scripts
evidence.finding: Inspector with diff tree, side-by-side/unified diffs, edit mode, actions Commit & Push, Create PR/MR, Pull Latest, Merge, Fix CI, Resolve Conflicts; agent-dispatched actions; GitHub and GitLab.

evidence.title: Stacked PRs
evidence.locator: whole page
evidence.finding: Stack workspaces with parent links; /helmor-cli stack, break, restack dispatch agents that create dependent workspaces.

evidence.title: CLI and MCP server
evidence.locator: Install; CLI Usage; MCP Server; Exposed Tools
evidence.finding: helmor CLI (repo, workspace, session, send, status, run-action, json output) and a stdio MCP server with nine tools; macOS and Windows install paths.

evidence.title: Configure your project
evidence.locator: helmor.json
evidence.finding: helmor.json setup/run/archive scripts per repository with env vars HELMOR_ROOT_PATH and HELMOR_WORKSPACE_PATH.

evidence.title: Settings
evidence.locator: Models; Accounts; Mobile companion; Experimental
evidence.finding: Provider keys, custom Claude-compatible providers, GitHub/GitLab accounts via bundled CLIs, shortcuts, update status, local LLM, experimental companion and CLI.

evidence.title: Repository guidance
evidence.locator: What is Helmor; Architecture
evidence.finding: Tauri v2 Rust host + React 19 frontend + Bun sidecar wrapping Claude Agent SDK, Codex CLI and OpenCode SDK; SQLite storage.

evidence.title: Tauri configuration
evidence.locator: bundle and updater
evidence.finding: Desktop bundle config for the Tauri app with updater pointing at release artifacts.

evidence.title: CLI argument definitions
evidence.locator: Workspace, Session, Send, RunAction, MergePr subcommands
evidence.finding: CLI subcommands include workspace new/list/show/stack/status/push/sync/run-action/set-status and send with --permission-mode plan|auto|yolo|default.

evidence.title: Agent system prompt
evidence.locator: stacked-layer prompt
evidence.finding: Product-authored prompt tells a layer agent to run `helmor workspace stack` and /helmor-cli restack; helmor-cli skill auto-loaded for agents.

evidence.title: Mobile companion
evidence.locator: module docs
evidence.finding: Localhost axum server mirroring IPC over HTTP/SSE for a phone browser through a Cloudflare tunnel with paired-device bearer tokens; gated behind HELMOR_COMPANION.

evidence.title: Forge inbox
evidence.locator: InboxToggles
evidence.finding: GitHub and GitLab issues, PRs/MRs and discussions surfaced as inbox items for starting work.

evidence.title: Slack context source
evidence.locator: module docs
evidence.finding: Slack used as a context source by importing the desktop client session on macOS; no in-app sign-in.

evidence.title: Rate-limit fetchers
evidence.locator: module docs
evidence.finding: Per-provider account rate-limit fetchers for Claude and Codex shown in the UI.

evidence.title: Sidecar session manager
evidence.locator: module
evidence.finding: Sidecar supervises agent sessions for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Kimi and OpenCode with abort, turn registry and git access.

evidence.title: Changelog
evidence.finding: Release 0.46.0 adds Claude Opus 5 model default and bundled agent updates; frequent minor releases; no dated roadmap.

evidence.title: Apache License 2.0
evidence.locator: header
evidence.finding: Apache License 2.0.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.locator: stargazers_count, license, pushed_at
evidence.finding: 1306 stars, Apache-2.0, pushed 2026-08-22, homepage helmor.ai; latest release v0.46.0 (2026-07-24).

evidence.title: Release v0.46.0 assets
evidence.locator: release asset list
evidence.finding: Assets: Helmor_0.46.0_aarch64.dmg, Helmor_0.46.0_x64.dmg, Helmor_0.46.0_x64-setup.exe plus updater tarballs; no Linux or mobile artifacts.

evidence.title: Bounded search: other clients
evidence.locator: grep over src/, src-tauri/src, sidecar/src, apps for linux appimage, deb, rpm, ios app, android app, vsix, vscode extension, jetbrains
evidence.finding: No Linux build, native mobile app or editor extension; companion is a browser client.

evidence.title: Bounded search: other harnesses
evidence.locator: grep for gemini, aider, antigravity, grok, goose, amp, copilot cli across sidecar/src and src-tauri/src/agents
evidence.finding: Agent adapters exist only for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Kimi and OpenCode; no generic adapter for arbitrary CLIs.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry
evidence.locator: grep for sentry, posthog, analytics, telemetry, amplitude, umami across src, src-tauri/src, sidecar/src, Cargo.toml, package.json
evidence.finding: No analytics or crash-reporting client found; only update checks and an explicit feedback feature.

evidence.title: Bounded search: collaboration and enterprise
evidence.locator: grep for rbac, organization, team member, sso, saml, presence, co-prompt, share across src, src-tauri/src
evidence.finding: No multi-user accounts, roles, SSO or shared prompting; companion pairs personal devices.

evidence.title: Bounded search: unattended triggers
evidence.locator: grep for cron, schedule, webhook, trigger across src-tauri/src and sidecar/src
evidence.finding: No scheduled or event-triggered agent runs; matches are UI/test internals.

evidence.title: Bounded search: cost tracking
evidence.locator: grep for cost, usd, spend, budget across src and src-tauri/src
evidence.finding: Only context-window usage and provider rate-limit displays; no dollar cost, spend or budgets.

evidence.title: Bounded search: native issue entity
evidence.locator: grep for issue tracker, backlog entity, ticket across src-tauri/src/models and src/features
evidence.finding: No native issue entity; status lanes label workspaces and the forge inbox reads GitHub/GitLab items.

evidence.title: Bounded search: container or VM isolation
evidence.locator: grep for docker, container, sandbox, vm across src-tauri/src and sidecar/src
evidence.finding: No container or VM isolation; sandbox mentions are agent-SDK and Slack-scrape internals.

evidence.title: Bounded search: hosted service and pricing
evidence.locator: grep for pricing, subscription, billing, sign up, cloud across README, docs/user, src-tauri/src
evidence.finding: No Helmor hosted service, account, pricing or billing; companion tunnel service uses Cloudflare.

evidence.title: helmor pinned source, bounded telemetry search
evidence.locator: Recursive search of . for posthog, segment, amplitude, mixpanel, sentry, aptabase, telemetry, DO_NOT_TRACK, google-analytics, gtag, firebase/analytics, opentelemetry
evidence.finding: No ADE analytics, telemetry or crash-reporting client in the pinned source. Matches are a dev-only frame logger and Sentry MCP tool names; the Tauri updater endpoint is GitHub Releases (src-tauri/tauri.conf.json). Consistent with the privacy doc stating no analytics pipeline.
